page.layout: One column of running text, full width, from top to bottom. No marginal notes, no footnotes.

main_text.l: certiorem: ac lætabor sane, meam tibi dili-
viderat, qui propterea pronunciare ausus est, non
alios Characteres siclis inesse, quam qui-
longe minorem, qui asservatur in Musæo
adeo detriti, ut nullum inde verbum
exculpi possit: ne quid tamen in me dili-
facie litteram Tau in similitudinem crucis
scriberetur X posterioribus temporibus in eam
itatem in causa fuisse existimo, ut enim
unico ductu calami efformaretur ita vi-detur

page.notes: The letter before "degeneravit" is a figure resembling a Ν with a stroke, probably a degenerated Tau; I could not read it with certainty, so it is marked [?]. The last word of the page is split across the line end as "vi-" / "detur" and is joined here with its printed hyphen. The running head and page number are read from the top line; the "1" of "150" uses an old form of the numeral.
